# Saarthi Studio

> Saarthi Studio is a creative web design and digital branding studio focused on premium landing pages, brand identity, conversion-focused websites, and thoughtful motion-driven experiences.

Important notes:

- The homepage is the primary entry point and contains the core studio overview, services, showcases, testimonials, FAQ, stats, and contact CTA.
- The site includes a blog for practical notes on branding, copy, design, and conversion, plus individual case studies for selected projects.
- The contact form is handled server-side through SvelteKit actions.
- The `thank-you` page should not be indexed.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://www.saarthistudio.com/): Studio overview and main marketing page
- [Blog](https://www.saarthistudio.com/blog): Studio journal with articles on strategy, copy, design, and motion
- [Case Studies](https://www.saarthistudio.com/case-studies/whimsy-walls): Example project detail page pattern
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.saarthistudio.com/privacy-policy): Privacy and data handling information
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.saarthistudio.com/terms-and-conditions): Website and service terms

## Blog

- [How to Plan a Brand Website That Converts: A Practical Framework](https://www.saarthistudio.com/blog/how-to-plan-a-brand-website-that-converts): Conversion-first homepage planning, proof placement, CTA strategy, and SEO quick wins
- [Saying More With Less Copy](https://www.saarthistudio.com/blog/saying-more-with-less-copy): Advice on concise copy, clarity, and editing for premium websites
- [What Makes a Modern Agency Portfolio Feel Premium](https://www.saarthistudio.com/blog/what-makes-a-modern-agency-portfolio-feel-premium): Notes on pacing, restraint, proof, and visual polish

## Examples

- [Whimsy Walls Case Study](https://www.saarthistudio.com/case-studies/whimsy-walls): Mobile-first artist portfolio focused on immersive artwork presentation
- [Mahesh Fishland Case Study](https://www.saarthistudio.com/case-studies/mahesh-fishland): Digital catalogue and WhatsApp-first ordering flow for a seafood business
- [Costa Blanca Car Rental Case Study](https://www.saarthistudio.com/case-studies/costa-blanca): Premium rental website with SEO and performance focus
- [Gita Flow Case Study](https://www.saarthistudio.com/case-studies/gita-flow): AI-powered Bhagavad Gita experience with a calm interface
- [Dr. Amol Bhere Ayurveda Case Study](https://www.saarthistudio.com/case-studies/amol-bhere): Digital presence for an Ayurvedic clinic
- [Iconic Beauty Salon Case Study](https://www.saarthistudio.com/case-studies/iconic-beauty-salon): Beauty and wellness site with WhatsApp booking flow

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.saarthistudio.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical list of indexable URLs
